headline: PSEi returns to 6,300 level as Mideast tensions ease
summary: The PSEi returned to the 6,300 level as declining oil prices lifted investor sentiment. The input links the easing to reduced Mideast tensions.
why: The PSEi is the Philippine Stock Exchange's main index, and the Philippines is a large oil importer, so oil prices affect local sentiment.
why_moved: Declining oil prices as Mideast tensions eased lifted investor sentiment and pushed the index back to 6,300.
